emulators._comment: LOCAL ONLY - lets `firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore` boot both for the demo-login E2E (y/tools/README-emulator-e2e.md). Ignored by deploys.

headers.comment: PWA: the service worker + manifest must NEVER be cached by the browser/CDN, otherwise app updates can't reach already-installed users. Everything the SW caches is versioned inside service-worker.js itself.
